items.headline: Nvidia posts $115.8B quarterly revenue (+103% YoY) and guides to $130B, its first report since its CEO resigned
items.why: The beat and a raised FY2028 growth outlook show AI chip demand is still accelerating, while the guide assumes no China data-center sales, so the number is not hostage to export approvals.

sources.title: Fox Business: Nvidia releases quarterly earnings after CEO resignation

items.headline: Anthropic prices the largest IPO on record: about $81B raised at $83 a share, roughly a $1.5T valuation
items.why: A record supply of new AI equity landed in the middle of an AI-led selloff, and the stock's opening pop faded the same session, which suggests investors are rationing capital for AI rather than adding to it.

items.headline: Bitcoin falls below $60,000 on Nov 20 for the first time since about July, with a low near $57,650
items.why: The break of a five-month floor came alongside the equity selloff and roughly $580M of outflows from US spot ETFs in one day, so crypto is trading as a high-beta risk asset, not a hedge.

sources.title: Forbes: Bitcoin plunges below $60,000 as risk-off trading fuels losses

items.headline: Bitcoin daily RSI near 19 as technicians flag a head-and-shoulders measured move toward $37,500
items.why: An RSI that low is deeply oversold and can allow a sharp bounce, but a failure to reclaim the $60,000 region keeps the lower target in play.

items.headline: Fed October minutes: nearly all officials see further rate hikes as likely; 10-year Treasury yield holds near 5.07%
items.why: With the hold decided 10-2 (both dissenters wanted a hike) and about 90% odds of a quarter-point hike on Dec 8-9, the policy path is tightening, which is what is pressuring gold, crypto and long-duration tech.

sources.title: CEO Economy: Fed minutes point to more rate increases

items.headline: A Fed governor says a 50bp December hike "could be considered"
items.why: It widens the range of outcomes for the Dec 8-9 meeting beyond the 25bp that markets already price, and the minutes also tied AI-infrastructure demand to inflation and financial-stability risk.

sources.title: KuCoin News: Fed minutes signal hawkish stance

items.headline: Gold slides to about $3,540 on Nov 20, its lowest since September 2025, down nearly 9% on the week
items.why: Hawkish Fed repricing and a stronger dollar are the stated drivers, and liquidity-driven selling from equities means gold is being sold as a source of cash rather than traded on its own fundamentals.

items.headline: Silver falls toward $43.21 with support at $39.47; gold watch levels $3,600 then about $3,496
items.why: Both metals are oversold (gold daily RSI about 26), so the support levels, not the trend, decide whether the move is washed out or still extending.

items.headline: S&P 500 proxy (SPY) closes near $715.87 on Nov 19, below $718.99 support; next levels $711.90 and about $696
items.why: A close below support turns the former floor into resistance, with $740 as the reclaim zone; the Nasdaq-100 proxy (QQQ) is also below its Nov 5 bearish candle, and a close under $644.44 targets about $625.

items.headline: 10-year Treasury yield sits just above 5%: support about 5.01%, reference level 5.157%
items.why: A hold above 5% keeps pressure on equity valuations, while a break lower would ease the main headwind cited across assets this week.

sources.title: CEO Economy: Fed minutes point to more rate increases
